articles.headline: Norway calls on Infantino to quit amid backing from Mexico, Argentina
articles.description: Norway's soccer federation president has called on Gianni Infantino to resign, saying there is "no trust" in him now, while Mexico and Argentina have expressed their support for the embattled FIFA president.

articles.headline: USMNT hasn't really improved under Poch: Will new contract change that?
articles.description: The USMNT hasn't meaningfully improved since Pochettino was first hired as coach -- and he just got a contract extension. What now?

articles.headline: CAF agree to support Gianni Infantino amid FIFA governance crisis
articles.description: The Confederation of African Football has thrown its full weight behind FIFA president Gianni Infantino, unanimously reaffirming its support for the embattled Swiss administrator.

articles.headline: Which big clubs are struggling with World Cup burnout?
articles.description: The World Cup was a great spectacle, but it was also hard work for the players, and as many of the game's stars return to their clubs to prepare for the 2026-27, which clubs are battling burnout the most?

articles.headline: Burley: FIFA as an organisation has 'gone down the toilet'

articles.headline: FIFPRO accuses Gianni Infantino of 'profound abuse of power' over World Cup plan
articles.description: FIFA chief Gianni Infantino has been accused of a "profound abuse of presidential power" by the world players' union.
